verdict.rationale: Asana's own docs show projects and status updates that can be read and reported on, which covers the status part of tracking initiatives. Nothing in the pack documents priority fields, team ownership, or an initiative or portfolio object. Missing for 10: documented priority field on initiatives, owning-team assignment, an initiative/portfolio-level tracking construct, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Learn to read status updates from Asana and share them in another tool.
Create and manage tasks and projects through natural language
